hazard_zones.name: Raccoon City (Downtown)
hazard_zones.description: Urban biological disaster zone. Complete viral outbreak confirmed. Chaos tier containment failure.

hazard_zones.name: Arklay Laboratory (Spencer Mansion)
hazard_zones.description: The hidden birthplace of the T-Virus. Underground facility entry guarded by complex logic traps.

subjects.name: Leon S. Kennedy
subjects.bio: Rookie police officer trapped on his first day. Highly adaptable, elite marksman skills, possessive of critical escape data.

subjects.name: Jill Valentine
subjects.bio: Expert in lock-picking and explosive logistics. Master survivor of the original Arklay Mountain incident.

subjects.name: Albert Wesker
subjects.bio: Former S.T.A.R.S. leader who betrayed humanity for viral mutation evolution. Possesses super-human combat metrics.

subjects.name: Nemesis T-Type
subjects.bio: Experimental cyborg organism programmed exclusively to track, target, and terminate elite combat units.
